weapons.name: Daybreak
weapons.source: Crafted (18 Solar Fragments, at an Ancient Manipulator)
weapons.why: Hurls sun spears that stick to enemies and inflict Daybroken.

weapons.name: Solar Eruption
weapons.source: Crafted (18 Solar Fragments, at an Ancient Manipulator)
weapons.why: Swings a long whipsword that passes through blocks and pierces infinitely.

weapons.name: Terra Blade
weapons.source: Crafted (True Excalibur + True Night's Edge + Broken Hero Swords)
weapons.why: Fires a fast green sword beam projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Flying Dragon
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3)
weapons.why: Fires a red crescent-shaped projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: The Horseman's Blade
weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: Summons homing pumpkin projectiles when hitting enemies.

weapons.name: The Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.source: Dropped by Mothron during a Solar Eclipse (occurs post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera Solar Eclipse Mothron drop with infinite spin.

weapons.name: Possessed Hatchet
weapons.source: Dropped by Golem
weapons.why: Homing hatchet dropped by Golem.

weapons.name: Flairon
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron (1/6)
weapons.why: Hardmode flail from Duke Fishron, who requires no boss prerequisite to summon.

weapons.name: Vampire Knives
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Crimson Chest (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of knives that heal the player on hit.

armor.name: Beetle Armor
armor.source: Crafted from Beetle Husks and Turtle Armor
armor.why: Beetles either raise melee damage and speed or absorb damage, depending on the chestplate you wear.

accessories.name: Fire Gauntlet
accessories.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.

accessories.name: Destroyer Emblem
accessories.why: The damage and crit boost continue to scale very well with Solar fragment weapons.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: Combines Celestial Stone and Moon Shell: all-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

buffs.name: Flask of Ichor
buffs.why: The defense shred still gives melee the best practical damage boost per buff slot.

items.name: Wings
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Amphibian Boots
items.why: Combines the effects of sprinting boots with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Doubles the length of the player's immunity frames (to 4/3 of a second), and summons falling stars when the player is hit.

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Charm of Myths
items.why: Combines the effects of a Philosopher's Stone with a Band of Regeneration:

items.name: Moon Stone
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Flesh Knuckles
items.why: Provides 8 defense, and increases the player's aggro by 400.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.why: In respect to offensiveness, the Moon Stone increases the following stats from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM:

items.name: Avenger Emblem
items.why: Increases the player's damage by 12%.

items.name: Papyrus Scarab
items.why: Increases summon damage by 15%, the player's minion slots by one, and the knockback of the player's summons. Note that all classes can easily benefit from extra minion damage.

items.name: Spore Sac
items.why: Creates poisonous spores around the player which damage enemies over time.

items.name: Putrid Scent
items.why: Increases damage by 5% and critical strike chance by 5%, and decreases the player's aggro by 400.
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). Strongly consider making a place to farm enemies for Souls of Night, as obtaining all three will no doubt be tedious.

items.name: Warrior Emblem
items.why: Increases melee damage by 15%.

items.name: Magic Yoyo Bag
items.why: Grants the following effects:

items.name: Mechanical Glove
items.why: Effectively combines the effects of an Avenger Emblem with a Power Glove by providing a +12% damage buff, but only to melee weapons (instead of universally, as the Avenger Emblem does).

items.name: Berserker's Glove
items.notes: Players seeking to use defensive setups that use the Hero Shield, Flesh Knuckles, and Berserker's Glove simultaneously will need a total of three Flesh Knuckles (or Putrid Scents to shimmer into them). weapons.name: Phantasm
weapons.source: Crafted from Vortex Fragments (Vortex Pillar)
weapons.why: Charges up to fire additional phantom arrows the longer it is held.

weapons.name: Vortex Beater
weapons.source: Crafted (18 Luminite Bars + Vortex Fragments)
weapons.why: Luminite-tier gun that fires bullets and homing rockets, crafted after Moon Lord.

weapons.name: Snowman Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ice Queen during the Frost Moon (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Fires homing rockets that track the nearest enemy.

weapons.name: Stake Launcher
weapons.source: Dropped by Mourning Wood (Pumpkin Moon)
weapons.why: A repeater that fires high-damage Stakes as its ammunition.

weapons.name: Xenopopper
weapons.source: Dropped by the Martian Saucer (Martian Madness)
weapons.why: Fires a spread of bullets and drops from the Martian Saucer during post-Golem Martian Madness.

armor.name: Shroomite Armor
armor.why: Standing still puts you in stealth, raising ranged damage and making enemies less likely to target you.

armor.name: Red Riding Armor
armor.source: Dropped by the Old One's Army, tier 3
armor.why: A ranged and summon hybrid: 25% summon and ranged damage, 20% chance to save ammo and 2 sentry slots. Wearing a Shroomite headpiece instead of the Hood keeps the ranged bonuses.

accessories.name: Sniper Scope
accessories.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.

accessories.name: Ranger Emblem
accessories.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
accessories.why: 15% ranged damage.

accessories.name: Fishron Wings
accessories.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

accessories.name: Celestial Shell
accessories.why: Combines Celestial Stone and Moon Shell: all-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

accessories.name: Ankh Shield
accessories.source: Crafted from Obsidian Shield and Ankh Charm.
accessories.why: Knockback immunity and immunity to most debuffs for the hardest fights.

accessories.name: Master Ninja Gear
accessories.source: Crafted from Tabi, Black Belt, and Climbing Claws (Tinkerer).
accessories.why: Dash, wall climbing, and a 10% chance to dodge an attack.

buffs.name: Archery Potion
buffs.why: Raises arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%. Bows only.

buffs.name: Ammo Reservation Potion
buffs.why: Ammo savings matter once your best weapons are firing constantly through pillar clears and Moon Lord attempts.

buffs.name: Ammo Box
buffs.why: It is still easy free value before every important fight.

ammo.name: Chlorophyte Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Musket Balls and a Chlorophyte Bar
ammo.why: Homes in on enemies. Less damage than a Crystal Bullet, but it rarely misses.

ammo.name: Ichor Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Musket Balls and Ichor
ammo.why: Lowers enemy defense. Crimson worlds only.

ammo.name: Holy Arrow
ammo.source: Crafted at a Mythril/Orichalcum Anvil from Wooden Arrows, Pixie Dust and a Unicorn Horn
ammo.why: Calls down falling stars on impact.

armor.name: Spectre Hood Loadout
